references.text: Parallel law text about the first day of the seventh month as a holy day of rest and trumpet blast (יום תרועה)
Introduction to the section on the Lord's feasts and holy convocations (מקרא קדש)
Instructions to blow trumpets on feast days and new moon days, linked to the concept of תרועה
Psalm mentioning trumpet blasts (שופר og תרועה) at the new moon and the feast, traditionally associated with the seventh month's festival
Ezra reads the law to the people on the first day of the seventh month, showing the celebration of this feast day
Nehemiah describes the people gathering on the first day of the seventh month to hear the law
Description of the trumpet blast (תרועה) on the Day of Atonement in the seventh month, the same month as this feast
